title: 第21章 遭遇伏击惊退对手第22章 拍卖会百年人参
content_zh:
“陈军这种墙头草，不能全信，你得培养自己的人。”张扬道。
“我已经物色了几个人选，你要不抽空见见？”
“不用，你觉得没问题就行。”
张扬摇了摇头，接着说，“我们夺下陈家，不是想要荣华富贵，而是希望用陈家的钱得到更多的修炼资源，必要时，现在拥有的一切都可以抛弃，只要命还在，咱们就能东山再起。”
“我已经派人在找高年份灵药，只是灵药太缺了，每出现一株，都被各大武道世家轰抢，很难找到。”
灵药不但对修仙者有用，也能提升武者的真气，被轰抢很正常。
“生意上的事情，你尽量找人去做，重心放在找灵药上面，只要我突破炼气三层，就能跟兰天庭这老匹夫拼一拼。”
几次被打压，张扬憋了一肚子气，急切需要提升实力，弄死这王八蛋。
“好。”
妖姬媚眼望了他一下，欲言又止。
“还有事吗？”
妖姬咬了咬牙，问：“你是不是嫌弃我了？”
张扬愣了一下，瞬间明白了。
从海边小镇回来，他没有跟妖姬双修过一次，反而找柳飘絮，妖姬看在眼里，心里早就有些伤感。
张扬捏着她漂亮得不像话的脸庞，笑道：“你也知道，咱们双修不是一个小时就能结束的，我怕你累坏了。”
“我现在有空。”妖姬低声说道。
这里不是安全地方，妖姬待在房间里面几个小时不出门，别人也会怀疑。
虽然张扬跟何诗韵产生了一些矛盾，但是何诗韵的体质，还是很吸引他的。
“你去找个安全的地方，咱们今晚见。”
“好。”

妖姬冰冷的脸上，这才露出一丝笑容。
“我的腰啊！”张扬感叹。
昨晚才跟柳飘絮加班，今晚这架势，又是决战到天亮的节奏。
还好修炼了《龙凤培元功》之后，肾足够好。
……
接下来的日子，兰家没再找张扬麻烦。
张扬乐得安静，不过他心里清楚，这只是暴风雨前的宁静。
妖姬提拔了几名新人，张扬对这些人一个都不信任，他们能背叛陈天龙，一样会背叛他。
平日里，张扬依然会出现在永春堂，当一名理疗师。
何诗韵手里的高质量女性挺多，可惜，有灵根的一个都没有。
张扬跟妖姬时不时双修，只不过地点都很隐蔽，不让任何人知道。
兰天庭不敢对张扬出手，他是忌惮妖姬，除非能将张扬跟妖姬同时干掉，漏掉任何一个人，兰家都会遭遇另外一个人疯狂报复。
鉴于此，张扬平时尽量少跟妖姬待在一起。
content_en:
"You can't trust someone like Chen Jun. You have to train your own people." Zhang Yang said.
"I have identified a few candidates, why don't you take the time to meet them?"
"No, as long as you think it's okay."
Zhang Yang shook his head and continued, "We took over the Chen family not because we want glory and wealth, but because we want to use the Chen family's money to get more cultivation resources. If necessary, everything we have now can be abandoned. As long as our lives are still there, we can make a comeback."
"I have sent people to look for high-year elixirs, but there is too little elixir. Every time one appears, it is snatched up by major martial arts families, making it difficult to find."
Spiritual elixirs are not only useful for immortal cultivators, but can also enhance a warrior's true energy, so it is normal for them to be robbed.
"For business matters, you try to find someone to do it, and focus on finding the elixir. As long as I break through the third level of Qi Refining, I can compete with this old man like Lan Tianting."
After being suppressed several times, Zhang Yang was filled with anger and urgently needed to improve his strength and kill this bastard.
"Okay."
The enchantress looked at him charmingly, but stopped talking.
"Is there anything else?"
The Enchantress gritted her teeth and asked, "Do you dislike me?"
Zhang Yang was stunned for a moment and understood instantly.
When he came back from the seaside town, he did not have a double cultivation with the enchantress once, but instead went to Liu Piaoxu. The enchantress saw this and felt a little sad in his heart.
Zhang Yang pinched her ridiculously beautiful face and said with a smile: "You also know that our dual cultivation will not be completed in an hour. I'm afraid you will be exhausted."
"I'm free now." Enchantress whispered.
This is not a safe place. If the enchantress stays in the room for several hours without going out, others will become suspicious.
Although Zhang Yang and He Shiyun had some conflicts, He Shiyun's physique still attracted him.
"You go find a safe place and we'll see you tonight."
"Okay."
Only then did a smile appear on the enchantress's cold face.
"My waist!" Zhang Yang sighed.
Liu Piaoxu and Liu Piaoxu worked overtime last night, and tonight's situation is like a decisive battle until dawn again.
Fortunately, after practicing the "Dragon and Phoenix Pei Yuan Gong", my kidneys are good enough.
…
In the days that followed, the Lan family did not cause any trouble for Zhang Yang.
Zhang Yang was happy and quiet, but he knew in his heart that this was just the calm before the storm.
Enchantress promoted several newcomers, but Zhang Yang did not trust any of these people. If they could betray Chen Tianlong, they would betray him as well.
On weekdays, Zhang Yang still appears at Yongchun Hall as a physical therapist.
He Shiyun has many high-quality women in his hands, but unfortunately, none of them have spiritual roots.
Zhang Yang and Enchantress practice dual cultivation from time to time, but the locations are always hidden and no one is allowed to know.
Lan Tianting did not dare to take action against Zhang Yang. He was afraid of Enchantress. Unless Zhang Yang and Enchantress could be killed at the same time, if anyone was missed, the Lan family would suffer crazy revenge from another person.
In view of this, Zhang Yang tries to stay with the enchantress as little as possible.
